gen-mystery-quest-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Nostalgic and bookish up top, Mystery Quest sets the tone. Carrois Gothic SC follows in a plain sans, friendly and approachable, with curves that stay open and capitals and lowercase nearly level, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-chivo: Chivo reads with lowercase packed close to the caps and daylight showing through every curve. Mystery Quest, with its jaw-like openings and compact ascenders, is the bookish half; the pair's strongest quality is how that old-fashioned flavor sits beside a sans this approachable.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-chocolate-classical: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest a bookish, nostalgic bite that you notice at once. It does display flavor best; Chocolate Classical Sans handles the sizable, broad-nibbed body text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-comme: Mystery Quest has open jaws on its curves and compact ascenders over tall lowercase, a bookish look from the first word. Comme works well as a sans below, ideally a size or two smaller.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-cossette-texte: Nostalgic in feel, Mystery Quest draws its heading in low-contrast, wirelike strokes with open curves. Cossette Texte answers underneath with wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height, so the heading sets the mood and the sans does the talking.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans fills the line with wide openings on small letters, while its ascenders hardly show. Mystery Quest handles the bookish, nostalgic flourish best; the sans simply carries the text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-fresca: Fresca reads modern and clean, with parallel stroke edges running through every curve. Across a long stretch, its short ascenders over big bowls and connected counters keep the text flowing without calligraphic thinning, a sans-serif that never fusses.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-funnel-sans: Mystery Quest's open jaws on every curve and compact ascenders give it a bookish, nostalgic look. Funnel Sans, a clean sans-serif, keeps its stroke widths steady, so a longer passage moves along smoothly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-gafata: Gafata reads as a tall band of letters under short stalks, with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes in a plain sans. Mystery Quest sits above it with bookish, nostalgic jaws, and the two split the work between mood and clarity.
